# Compiler v10 historical writer

Generated using `loadPragmaProject` and `PragmaProject.createLock` from the
unmodified Interpreter sources archived from commit `32acd6c6`. The synthetic
DSL v6 Expert includes explicit `ask` and `required` policies. The lock and resource
hashes are actual v10 writer output; no lock version literals were substituted.

The v10→v11 migration validates the original lock and preserves all resource
fields and explicit approval policies. Source files remain immutable.
